preconditions.description: Number of factories is within the specified range.
Number of businessmen is within the specified range.
Number of years is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= parent[i] <= i for i in range(N-1))
preconditions.description: Each factory's parent is within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= B[i] <= M for i in range(N))
preconditions.description: Each factory is owned by a valid businessman.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= threshold[i] <= 10**18 for i in range(M))
preconditions.description: Each businessman's threshold is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= F <= N for F, X, D in donations)
preconditions.description: Each donation's factory is within the valid range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= X <= 10**6 for F, X, D in donations)
preconditions.description: Each donation's amount is within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= D <= 10**6 for F, X, D in donations)
preconditions.description: Each donation's increment is within the specified range.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly M lines.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in [str(year) for year in range(1, Q+1)] + ['rekt'] for i in range(M))
postconditions.description: Each line in the output is either a valid year or 'rekt'.
